_doc: The slot of MakerBeamXL, the 15 x 15 mm beam: 3 mm between lips 1 mm thick, a cavity 5.5 mm wide and 2.5 mm high under them with straight walls (so no floor_width is given), and a groove 3 mm wide down the middle of its floor to 5 mm from the face. A plain M3 nut slides in: "M3 DIN934 nuts will slide into the beam". Figures are from MakerBeam's drawing of 2025; its overview of 2016 gave the lip as 1.1 and the cavity as 5.7. The drawn slot leaves out the rounds (R0.3 and R0.5 on the overview's drawing).
name: slot-3-makerbeam-xl

opening.rule: Between the lips: 3 on the drawing
opening.source: MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 103149 "beam black anodised" (MakerBeamXL, L = 100 mm, 13-10-2025), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the underside of the lip: 1,0 on the drawing (1.1 on the overview of 2016)
lip_thickness.source: MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 103149 "beam black anodised" (MakerBeamXL, L = 100 mm, 13-10-2025), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips: 5,5 on the drawing (5.7 on the overview of 2016)
cavity_width.source: MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 103149 "beam black anodised" (MakerBeamXL, L = 100 mm, 13-10-2025), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the cavity's floor: the lip's 1,0 and the 2,5 under it, both on the drawing
cavity_depth.source: MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 103149 "beam black anodised" (MakerBeamXL, L = 100 mm, 13-10-2025), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

groove_width.rule: A groove down the middle of the floor, as wide as the opening: 3 on the overview's drawing
groove_width.source: MakerBeam B.V., "overview specifications MB, MBXL, OB with pictures" (20161130), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

groove_depth.rule: The groove goes to 5 from the face on the drawing: 1.5 below the cavity's floor
groove_depth.source: MakerBeam B.V., technical drawing 103149 "beam black anodised" (MakerBeamXL, L = 100 mm, 13-10-2025), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/

nut_family.rule: It takes a plain M3 nut (DIN 934: 5.5 across flats), slid in from an end: "M3 DIN934 nuts will slide into the beam". MakerBeam's T-slot nuts for MakerBeamXL fit OpenBeam too
nut_family.source: MakerBeam B.V., "overview specifications MB, MBXL, OB with pictures" (20161130), in MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawings folder, https://www.makerbeam.com/technical-drawings/
